ORDER This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred feeling aggrieved by the order dated 23.06.2022 in MVC No.2486/2018 by IIIrd Additional Member, MACT, Jabalpur (M.P.) for enhancement of Rs.6,00,000/-.

2 . Facts in brief are that appellant-Rajesh Kumar filed an application und er Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 for compensation of Rs.21,00,000/- due to permanent physical disability caused in motor accident dated 03.06.2018 at 8 pm at Saliwada, near Rajjan dairy, main road Gaur, P.S.
Barela District Jabalpur.

It is submitted that respondent no.1 Sunil Kumar driving the truck bearing no. MP-20-HB-2352 negligently caused the injuries to appellant offending vehicle was owned by respondent no.2 and insured by respondent no.3 where he suffered 40% physical disability despite treatment at Jamdar Hospital and Medical Hostpial Jabalpur.

sentences.text: This claim was filed through next friend who is the wife of the appellant.
3. Respondents no.1 and 2 did not appear and respondent no.3 contested the claim on various grounds including breach of conditions of policy.

4. Tribunal framed the issues and recorded the evidence of appellant- Rajesh Kumar as PW-1, Dr.
Sharad Dwivedi as PW-2 and admitted the documents as Ex.P-1 to P-38.

Respondents examined the Assistant Grade III RTO Jabalpur Dheeraj Khare as DW-1 and Administrative Officer in Insurance Company Shri Himanshu Gupta as DW-2 and exhibited the documents Ex.D-1 and D-2.
5.
Appreciating the evidence, Tribunal found proved that appellant suffered driving of respondent no.1 and the offending vehicle was owned by respondent no.2 and insured by respondent no.3.
Tribunal also concluded that the age of appellant was 41 years at the date of accident and by the work of unskilled labour, his income was Rs.7325/- per month.

Tribunal also concluded that the permanent physical disability of appellant was proved only 10% and awarded a total compensation of Rs.2,75,546/- in the following heads :-
1- for loss of income due to 10% permanent 1,53,825/-
 physical disability  2- for medical expenses   3- for mental and physical pain   4- for attendant, special diet   5- for loss of income during treatment   6- for future treatment
The appellant has to suffer the pain throughout his life.
Future treatment has been avoided in physical condition of the appellant and inflation in medical expenses, attendant, nutrition diet and traveling expenses have not been adequately compensated.
It requires enhancement of Rs.50,000/-.
Loss of income during treatment is on the lower side.

Permanent physical disability should have been enhanced 50% in instead of 10%.
7.
Learned counsel for the respondent supported the findings of Tribunal and prayed for rejection of appeal.
8. Perused the record.

sentences.text: Considering the percentage of physical permanent disability, Tribunal has discussed the evidence of Dr. Sharad Dwivedi (PW-2) in para-13 and 14 of the award.
As per Ex.P-18, appellant was treated for right arm and fore arm.
Dr. Sharad Dwivedi has stated in cross-examination that he is not in position to calculate the permanent physical disability with response to the full body.

It mentioned that the injury of appellant was in right hand and also mentioned that the appellant was admitted to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Medical Hospital, Jabalpur on 04.06.2018 and continued to admit in the hospital till 08.08.2018 and thereafter transfer to ward no.14.

entities.text: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Medical Hospital, Jabalpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The job of the appellant is physical labour which depends on right hand.

So in the light of conclusion of para-13 of the award,
the permanent physical disability is assessed as 20%.
On the basis of 20% permanent physical disability, the appellant is entitled for enhancement of further compensation of Rs.1,53,825/-.
Rest of the heads are adequately compensated.
10. This appeal is partly allowed and further compensation of Rs.1,53,825/- is further enhanced in the head of loss of future income.
The appellant shall also be entitled for interest of @6% per annum on the enhanced amount from the date of application i.e. 28.04.2018.
The enhanced amount shall be disbursed as per the conditions of the Tribunal.
